reviewSamples.text:
James Macon and his team did an excellent job at installing electricity to my shed/office.  They were responsive and went above and beyond to get this projected completed within my timeframe.
I will definitely use them again.

reviewSamples.text: James was quick to respond to our emergency! A tree limb fell on the service power wire at my rental property. James had it fixed quickly, and was very proactive about communication. Job well done.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Olivia Story
reviewSamples.text: James is a very reliable, skilled,  and polite electrician. He trouble shooted a problem with my bathroom light and was able to fix, replace it. I highly recommend Macon Electric!
